items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier and Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-01-18
items.q: the John Rocha band, he'd have that same snag drum beat

ctx.x: How about when you would be playing the rags, you know, you would play maybe some rags in them days, would you keep all on snare drums playing some?

Yeah, same, that's how we'd change the beats, like I tell you, the variety of beats, just change them accordingly, that's all I could explain, you know what I mean, whatever you're playing. But that's how we played all the, there was the same drag that he was doing just now. Yeah. Now, see, some drummers might do this, you see, like he'd be playing, like, dun, dun, dun, dun. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. I used to do a buck and wing dance, tap dance, you know, buck dance years ago on the old shows. When he'd be…
I think that's his name is Bolton.
